name: NGC 6139 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6139, a globular cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6139-hubble
story: A massive globular cluster, a gravitationally bound collection of aging stars that orbits the Milky Way. Hubble studied it among clusters that might harbor a black hole at their centers.

claims.text: NGC 6139 is a massive globular cluster, a gravitationally bound collection of stars that orbits the Milky Way
NGC 6139 is home to an aging population of stars
NGC 6139 was a target of HST program 11628, 'Globular Cluster Candidates for Hosting a Central Black Hole'
